distribution.summary: 重庆；福建；海南；香港；湖北；湖南；陕西；四川；西藏；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) and Smith et al. (2020) support the current mainland and Taiwan distribution. Beaver & Liu (2010), under the source name Cnestus murayamai, independently supports Taiwan; current distribution is unchanged. Lau (2025) provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) and Smith et al. (2020) hosts are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds Actinodaphne lancifolia, Machilus thunbergii and Quercus aliena; Cinnamomum camphora was already present and is independently supported, including a Taiwan breeding record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cnestus aterrimus (Eggers, 1927).

nomenclature_note: 黄复生等 (2015) used Cnestus maculatus, while Beaver & Liu (2010) used Cnestus murayamai. Both source-specific names are retained as nomenclatural provenance under the current canonical identity Cnestus aterrimus.
